params.name: Landscaping reputation loss reduction
params.tooltip: Divides the town reputation loss from landscaping (terrain brush, terrain alignment of constructions, tunnels) by this factor. In the base game, 2 million cubic metres of moved earth cost a town 100% reputation; at 100x it takes 200 million, at 2000x 4 billion. Other reputation losses (trees, rocks, demolished buildings) stay unchanged.

params.name: Terraforming cost reduction
params.tooltip: Divides the cost of raising and lowering terrain (per cubic metre) by this factor. Off keeps the base game's prices. Applied when a game is loaded, so after changing it, save and load the game.

params.name: Debug mode
params.tooltip: When on, clicking a town (its name sign or one of its buildings) resets that town's reputation to full. A penalty for currently interrupted main connections stays.
